item.title: Google Cloud Fraud Defence is just WEI repackaged
item.description:
📝 The requirements page specifies the hardware that qualifies: “modern Android device with Google Play Services installed, or modern iPhone/iPad. Google Play Services is Google’s closed-source software layer that runs on certified Android devices and provides the attestation APIs - the Play Integrity API specifically - that prove a device is unmodified and approved by Google. A device without Play Services cannot satisfy Play Integrity checks at the level Fraud Defense requires.
🔗 Read more: https://privatecaptcha.com/blog/google-cloud-fraud-defence-wei/
